title: The Closed-World Trap: Why Fixed ImageNet Labels Stunted Vision

beats.text: Training vision models on fixed labels is a relic; it forces the model to ignore everything outside that specific bucket.
beats.visual_focus: A rigid 1,000-cell grid filling with labels.

beats.text: The villain is the 'Softmax wall'—a gated threshold that forces a singular, discrete guess, blinding the system to any novel concept.
beats.visual_focus: A Softmax function collapsing complex probability distributions into a single, sharp spike.

beats.text: CLIP pivots by using natural language as a bridge; it maps images and captions into a shared, high-dimensional joint embedding space.
beats.visual_focus: Text and image vectors converging toward the same coordinate center.
